verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence addresses an AI-training policy or opt-out. The only relevant support is indirect: Typesense is GPL-3.0 open source with the complete API surface, and it can be self-hosted on your own machine or servers. That keeps indexed data inside your own infrastructure rather than with the vendor (docs-39, docs-61, docs-50). Typesense Cloud is a hosted SaaS, and no documented commitment covers how customer data there is used. Missing for 10: an explicit no-training data-use policy, a training opt-out control for Typesense Cloud, and independent corroboration of its data-handling practices.
